verdict.stance: Overweight / Zero-HoldCo-Debt Georgian Conglomerate (Upgraded BB Stable)
verdict.summary: S&P upgraded Georgia Capital to BB Stable in June 2026 following sustained deleveraging. In Aug-26 CGEO exercised its call option on the final $50m of its $150m SLB, reaching zero HoldCo gross debt and -0.9% NCC at 3Q26 while NAV hit a record GEL 6.46bn (+28.6% YTD) and private portfolio EBITDA grew 26.3% YoY.

positives: Zero HoldCo gross debt following Aug-26 final $50m call on its $150m SLB; NCC ratio -0.9%.
Record NAV GEL 6.46bn (GEL 198.91/sh, +28.6% YTD) anchored by Lion Finance Group (BGEO) stake and private assets.
S&P upgraded to BB Stable (Jun-26); private portfolio 9M26 revenue +18.5% and EBITDA +26.3% YoY.
negatives: Concentrated Georgian macro/political risk and GEL FX sensitivity.
High NAV weighting to listed Lion Finance Group (BGEO) shares.
Limited direct USD bond float post-Aug-26 early redemption unless new HoldCo/opco issuance occurs.

background.business_overview: LSE-listed Georgian investment holding company (CGEO) owning ~19%+ of Lion Finance Group (BGEO) and controlling stakes in Georgian healthcare, pharmacy, insurance, renewable energy, and education.
background.asset_perimeter: Listed Lion Finance Group stake plus private portfolio (Georgia Healthcare Group, Aldagi Insurance, Education, Renewables).
background.ownership_governance: LSE Premium Listed (CGEO); strong institutional governance.
